mustbesimo-web-design-studio-cinematic-s.description: Design and build cinematic websites, interactive portfolios, product stories, and real-time 3D experiences with subject-specific art direction and scroll choreography. Use for new builds, redesigns, motion improvements, scroll audits, or storyboards in standalone HTML and existing apps; includes responsive, reduced-motion, and static fallbacks. Not for ordinary dashboards or unrelated animation.

mustbesimo-web-design-studio-launch-page.description: Decide what a launch, landing or product page must say and prove before any design or motion work. Use for a landing page, launch page, waitlist, pricing page copy or conversion brief, including requests about a headline, call to action, objections, proof or "what should the page say". Establish the audience, offer, traffic context and credible evidence, then deliver a story brief for cinematic-scroll. Use for new pages or message revisions, without prescribing a visual style or inventing business facts.

mustbesimo-web-design-studio-scroll-audi.description: Audit a live website's or local page's scroll experience and return a scored remediation plan. Use for an audit, review, score or benchmark request about scroll performance, parallax, pinned sections, scroll-jacking, reduced motion or motion accessibility, including "why does this page feel janky". Inspect authorised targets, separate observed behavior from unavailable evidence, and prioritise repairs across pacing, performance, accessibility and emotional arc. This skill diagnoses existing pages; it does not build or publish them.
